name: Roasted Salmon & Asparagus with Lemon-Dill Yogurt Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and position rack in the center.
Wash asparagus and snap off woody ends. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Peel and mince garlic. Sprinkle ⅔ of it over the asparagus (save the rest for the sauce).
Drizzle asparagus with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Turn to coat.
Place salmon in the middle of the sheet, moving asparagus to the sides. Rub salmon with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place in the oven and roast until salmon is opaque and asparagus is tender, 10-12 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by mixing together remaining garlic, lemon juice, yogurt, dill, salt, and pepper.
To serve, place asparagus and salmon on a plate, drizzle with yogurt sauce, and garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
